description: This Java test source file contains unit tests for the class `DefaultBasicHealthCheckConfig` in the package `org.eclipse.ditto.services.utils.health.config`. It verifies immutability, equality/hash code consistency, and default/configured values behavior of the health check configuration class.

classes.name: DefaultBasicHealthCheckConfigTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the `DefaultBasicHealthCheckConfig` class, verifying immutability, equality properties, and configuration value retrieval.

methods.description: Initializes the test fixture by loading the health-check configuration file before any tests run.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that instances of `DefaultBasicHealthCheckConfig` are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that the `DefaultBasicHealthCheckConfig` class correctly implements `equals` and `hashCode`.

methods.name: underTestReturnsDefaultValuesIfBaseConfigIsEmpty
